comment: Android's Bluetooth (AndroidBluetoothBridge, RootBluetooth) for the Linux side's BlueZ D-Bus service shared/platform/bluez.py (rungic-plasma-bluetooth), over the independent hardware socket (RUNGIC_DEVICE_SOCKET; explicit legacy RUNGIC_PLATFORM_SOCKET, one JSON object per line each way, one request per connection; errors {"error": string}). Every request is op bluetooth with an action. state: the adapter (enabled, name, address, discovering), its bonded devices (bond 12: bonded) and those found while discovering (gone after two minutes); the service polls it every few seconds. power, discover, pair, unpair, connect, disconnect and name change things (pairing is confirmed in Android's dialog) and are never sent by the provider check. Tested from both ends: tools/tests/test_contract_bluetooth.py (the real service, with a recording D-Bus connection, against tools/contracts.py's stand-in) and acceptance scenario contract.bluetooth (the Rungic app on the phone; names and addresses are blanked there).
